program: testdata/rhtest/engine-clang.exe
function: float_reader at 0x4012d0
step: promote
vector: 1
difference: memory at 0xc0000e20: recorded 00, replayed nothing (the first of 8 bytes)

The machine level replays equal; `promote` is the first step that differs. 0xc0000e20 lies in
the lift's own globals as the record lays them out from 0xc0000000 (the x87 stack and its
fellows), which the promoted level places elsewhere. Bisect writes no case ahead of `promote`,
since a case cannot load the machine state, so this note stands for the case until the
promotion of `float_reader` is fixed or a case can carry the state.
